question: Under a declared, measured low host-load condition, do the A03/V03 emulator spoken-ACK failures and guest HAL faults recur on the null1 platform?

hypothesis.text: Host scheduling/memory contention contributes to the emulator audio-path stalls observed in sdk1/null1.
interpretation: Recurring HAL faults under a met low-load condition would argue against host load as a necessary condition (not against every load contribution).
Absence of faults in five trials is consistent with H3b but does not establish it or show that the intermittent loss is repaired.
Any trial whose own window violates the load condition is reported as such; it is not a low-load trial.

singleChange: Host load condition only (owner-reduced host workload). No model, grammar, threshold, production capture, parent, audio fixture, gain/padding, pacing guard or deadline change.
declaredDifferencesFromNull1: Launch from a stopped guest (null1 followed an identity-checked kill of a running guest and an 8 s wait).

The guest boots at its own restored baseline (airplane 0, Wi-Fi 1, mobile data 1). The working state (airplane 1/Wi-Fi 0/data 0, lead 0, reply text, quiet hours off, delivery on, full-screen off) is applied by allow-listed radio commands and the reviewed suite configure right after the baseline is verified; null1 inherited it. The guest is briefly online during boot.
Bounded stabilization wait (>=300 s after boot_completed and idle emulator CPU) before preflight; null1 started its probe minutes after boot.
No probe trial before the cohort (null1 ran an excluded A03 probe); no additional recognition probe is authorized.
Host-load preflight and pre-trial gates, fresh per-trial clock probes, ownership checks and explicit stop rules (null1 had none of these).

hostMachine.securityProtections: Defender and other protections stay enabled; the agent terminates no user application

thresholdRationale.admission: Pre-launch, guest stopped, >=30 s. Available memory >=6.5 GiB = SDK-effective guest RAM 2.5 GiB + 1 GiB emulator/GPU overhead + 3 GiB post-boot floor. Available commit >=7.5 GiB = 3.5 GiB guest+overhead + 4 GiB floor. Total CPU median <=15% / p95 <=30% of 12 logical CPUs before the guest adds load. Hard paging median <=25/s, p95 <=250/s. Scheduling probe (2 ms sleeps) max lateness <=30 ms (under one third of the 100 ms producer guard) and median per-second p99 <=2 ms.
thresholdRationale.guest: Post-boot preflight (>=60 s) and every pre-trial window (last 20 s). Available memory >=3 GiB (~20% of RAM) and commit >=4 GiB so guest RAM is not paged. Non-emulator CPU (processor total minus emulator, harness and telemetry; keeps unattributed kernel/DPC time) median <=12% / p95 <=25%, leaving >=5 logical CPUs beyond the 4 vCPUs and helpers. Same paging and scheduling limits; telemetry <=1% of host CPU; no sample gap >3 s.
thresholdRationale.stabilization: >=300 s after boot_completed and emulator median CPU <=12% of host over 60 s, bounded at 20 min.
thresholdRationale.clock: 21 adb date probes; the minimum-RTT probe gives offset +/- RTT/2 (the guest read lies inside the host interval); 7 probes before and after each trial. The old +0.44 s offset is not reused.

measuredBeforeFreezing: Host-only sampler test (40 s, no emulator) before freezing: available memory median ~0.6 GiB, hard paging up to ~6500 pages/s, total CPU median 29%, scheduling probe max 18.5 ms; sampler mean CPU 0.39% of host. The host did not meet the admission condition then.

telemetry.interval: 1 s PDH counters plus a 2 ms scheduling-latency probe thread; UTC and system-wide monotonic (QPC) per row
telemetry.classification: emulator = qemu-system*/emulator.exe/netsimd.exe; harness = descendants of registered helper PIDs plus adb.exe; telemetry = sampler; other = everything else
telemetry.privacy: Counters and process image names only; raw JSONL private under .local; public evidence gets aggregates only. No command lines (except the emulator engine line verified for audio arguments), window titles or user data.
telemetry.coverage: Admission, boot stabilization, preflight, every trial and restoration.
telemetry.limit: 1 s CPU averages cannot rule out short stalls; the probe measures its own host thread, not emulator threads.

fixtures: Independent fresh registered fixtures per trial through the unchanged reviewed parent
protocolPreserved: gain 500 permille, padding 1000 ms each side, delay 0
anchored 20 ms realtime single-RPC sender with 100 ms lateness/lag guards
native gate 12 s, production capture 15 s, ringing 60 s
fresh visible hold; Answer does not ACK or record
independent SQLite assertions; ACK leaves task TODO; snooze one replacement generation

stop: guest stall or outstanding controller (240 s bound)
unknown controller ownership (test process, active instrumentation or foreign emulator-port client)
privacy guard (host microphone not OFF after source or at end) or restoration failure
missing essential telemetry (stale sampler, >3 s gap, or no HAL record for a trial that reached Recording)
producer pacing abort (lateness/lag guard or literal ABORT)
preflight or pre-trial low-load condition not met within 120 s
continueAfterCleanup: COMPLETED_RECOGNITION_MISMATCH (source RPC completed host-OFF, gate ALLOW, reference mismatch)
stopRules.remainingSlots: NOT_RUN; no silent retry, replacement trial, probe or second cohort
stopRules.reporting: HAL faults and load-condition violations are reported separately and never change a trial status or erase an end-to-end failure; invalid recognition trials are not ASR accuracy results.

comparisonWithNull1: Same evidence layers per trial: generator bytes offered, RPC outcome, visible Recording, native gate, captured signal (HAL record, energy ratio), recognition (reference comparison), review/Confirm, durable SQL; plus host load (absent for null1).
restoration: identity-checked emu kill of Medium_Phone; zero engines
ifAdmissionUnmet: No launch. Ask the owner for one concrete action (close non-essential applications, keeping Defender and security protections on) and wait; never relabel a busy run as low load.
limits: Five trials bound only this cohort under these conditions. Even five passes would not show that intermittent audio loss is repaired, and do not pass Phase 08.
